comparison.objective: Erect and latch all walls of a folding crate.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-wall manipulation and engagement of four sprung corner catches.
comparison.success_condition: All corners latch, walls and base meet pose limits, the crate remains on the table, and it is released stably.
comparison.reason: Catch latching and large articulated-object handling are meaningfully different from coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact regulation, and millimetre-scale tang recovery.
